g.text: Labels: % of ‘lesbian’ / % of ‘femslash’ works. F/F-category works only; all co-tags shown except those defining either family.

g.text: Method: weighted log-odds with informative Dirichlet prior (Monroe, Colaresi & Quinn 2008), work-level counts. Data: GOLEM.
